title: docs(readme): Revamp README
body:
This is a proposal to improve our README to become more attractive to developers relying on READMEs.

As Algolia is going more mature, I thought it would be an opportunity to work on the image of InstantSearch to appear more mature as well. We're getting more exposure so I think it's important to take time to work on this.

This PR is to trigger discussion and to work on it together. Let me know if I'm taking any wrong directions.

## Main changes

* Change to newer logo
* Remove emojis in titles because they break hyperlinks (we can find a solution if we really need them)
* Add badges to bring more confidence
* Update getting started code snippet to ES2015
* Link to getting started CodeSandbox
* Add a clear "Documentation" section
* Add a "Demos" section to see what you can build with InstantSearch.js
* Add a "Playground" section that links to the template generated with [Create InstantSearch App](https://github.com/algolia/create-instantsearch-app)
* Reword the "Contributing" section
* Add "License" section

## Things to consider

* Need to update other flavors' README
